summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, furnishing a First Supplemental Indenture dated the same day with The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch, as trustee, solely for incorporation into its Form F-3 registration statement. The filing documents issuance of $700,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.750% Notes due 2036 and includes exhibits covering the supplemental indenture and Davis Polk & Wardwell London and US legal opinions. This is a routine debt securities issuance, not a special situation. Watch for any use of proceeds disclosure or leverage commentary, but no deal or event-driven arbitrage angle exists.
